newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers dip $1, holiday calms Mediterranean.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers dip $1, holiday calms Mediterranean.

text.p: ARA bunkers dipped by a dollar on Monday, while bunkers went unquoted in southern Europe, the region quiet due to the Epiphany public holiday, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST traded in a range of $117/$118 fob late.
Traders said the bunker market led the barge market for once, the lack of end-user demand being the key.
Shipping problems due to frozen waterways limited movements.
Hamburg prices were similarly $1 a tonne lower at $120/$121.
Mediterranean activity was very muted, but French bunkers were at least offered, down $1 from Friday's levels. Brokers said the south of France was running short of 180 CST.
Egyptian bunker prices were also down $1.
